notes.touch: Read from source: Google kernel/devices/google/raviole@81506b991a5385be6c59ee27df4dda2b1379c507 dts/gs101-oriole-touch.dtsi includes gs101/gs101-fts-touch.dtsi (the same shared file bluejay uses) and sets only st,dchip_id <0x36 0x48>, st,max-coords <1079 2399>, panel samsung_s6e3fc3, udfps/offload/firmware names. Checked 2026-10-27 that nothing else in the oriole tree overrides the bus, pins or rails: no spitouch/spi_11/usi11/LDO25M/LDO26M/gpp23 reference in gs101-oriole*.dts(i) or the gs101-raviole*.dtsi they include (gpa9-2 is the fingerprint IRQ, gpp26-3 the eSE reset: other pins). Google kernel/gs branch android-gs-raviole-5.10-android13-qpr3 arch/arm64/boot/dts/google/gs101-fts-touch.dtsi and gs101-common-touch.dtsi give spi_11 at 10 MHz, CS gpp23-3, SPI gpp23-0..2, IRQ gpa9-0, reset gpp26-0, TS_SPI_SEL gpp26-1, rails m_ldo25_reg (DVDD 1.8 V) / m_ldo26_reg (AVDD 3.3 V): identical to bluejay; gs101-whitefin2-pmic.dtsi only renames LDO31M. OBSERVED 2026-10-27 (hardware/ios-boot-2026-10-27-boot5.txt): at XNU handoff USI11 is in mode 0, all seven pads func 0, TS_SPI_SEL not driven low, so the driver stops at the mux check without sweettouchmux=1.
